notes: Datasheet covers four orderable parts (3HE16564AA ZR -10dBm, 3HE16565AA ZR+ -10dBm, 3HE18360AA ZR+ 0dBm 0/70C, 3HE18358AA ZR+ 0dBm w/ToF 0/75C). Operating environment lists 0-75°C; part descriptions include 0/70C and 0/75C. Center frequency stated as ITU 196.1 to 191.7 THz; grid min/max also given as 191.300000/196.100000 THZ and 191.275000/196.125000 THZ. Adjustable/default optical power for ZR/ZR+ -10dBm: "-10 dBm to -6 dBm". Optical power out of TX port during tuning: -20 dBm. ZR overload on RX port: 0 dbm; ZR+ 0dBm tables list Maximum Receiver Signal Power 0 dBm and Maximum Receiver Total Power 13 dBm. CD tolerance on 3HE16565AA 400G open-zrp-ofec2 row includes qualifier "Low PMD, Low Pwr Consumption, CD = 13000ps/nm". Roll-off parameter β = 0.2 (raised-cosine), not necessarily percent. Reach values 40 km, 120 km, 600 km, 750 km from narrative application text, not single-module spec table rows. European decimal commas appear in source (e.g. 0,01 dB; 2,400 ps/nm).
